summary: A JLT dental clinic appears to lose bookings because stats read zero and appointments only reach a generic form.

findings.problem: The hero counters appear to read 0 for Advanced Dental Treatments, Happy Smiles Transformed and Years of Clinical Excellence, while a 15 plus years badge appears.
findings.cost: Zeros contradict your own claims and weaken trust.

findings.problem: Make Appointment and Contact Us appear to go to the same contact page, and the forms appear to have no date, time or treatment fields.
findings.cost: Patients cannot pick a slot, so many leave.
findings.fix: A real booking form with date and time.

findings.problem: The Services menu appears to link to #, and testimonial names appear run together such as William HallManager.
findings.cost: Dead links and garbled quotes look unfinished.

findings.problem: No street address or prices appear, doctor photo file names appear to suggest generated images, and one profile appears twice with different titles.
findings.cost: Patients want a real address, real dentists and clear prices.
findings.fix: Address, real photos and a price guide.
